export CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR="/private/tmp/claude-501/pr86-ci-live/lt/runs/sysspec107/fx" && cd -- "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" && [ "$(pwd -P)" = "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" ] && export PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1; R="$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR"; P=$R/plugins/system-spec-harness; S=$R/system-spec; python3 -B $P/scripts/validate-coverage-matrix.py --matrix $S/spec-state.json --require-complete --require-basis --require-foundation; echo g1=$?; python3 -B $P/scripts/validate-source-citation.py --targets $S/spec-state.json --references $S/fetched-references.json --state $S/spec-state.json --repo-root $R; echo g2=$?; python3 -B $R/plugins/dev-graph/scripts/validate-graph-schema.py --graph $R/.dev-graph/state/graph.json --repo-root $R --strict-artifact-readiness >/dev/null; echo g3=$?; python3 -B $P/skills/assign-system-spec-completeness-evaluator/scripts/aggregate-completeness.py --report $R/eval-log/system-spec-completeness-report.json --spec-dir $S --session c0ac8162-0bf1-4615-9b58-3c401e528e43 2>&1 | tail -c 300; echo agg=${pipestatus[1]}; shasum -a 256 eval-log/system-spec-completeness-report.json system-spec/spec-state.json; python3 -B - <<'PY'
import json,hashlib,pathlib
root=pathlib.Path('.')
r=json.load(open('eval-log/system-spec-completeness-report.json'))
arts=r['artifact_snapshot']['artifacts']
print('snapshot mismatch',[k for k,v in arts.items() if hashlib.sha256((root/k).read_bytes()).hexdigest()!=v], len(arts))
print('aspects',{k:v['verdict'] for k,v in r['aspects'].items()})
print('deleg',[(d['component'],d['verdict']) for d in r['audit_delegations']])
g=json.load(open('eval-log/run-dev-graph-system-spec-goal-spec.json'))
h=hashlib.sha256(g['original_goal'].encode()).hexdigest(); print('goalhash',h, g['original_goal_hash']==h)
rows=[json.loads(l) for l in open('eval-log/run-dev-graph-system-spec-intermediate.jsonl') if l.strip()]
print('rows',len(rows))
for row in rows:
  print(sorted(row.keys())[:8], row['original_goal_hash']==h, row['original_goal']==g['original_goal'])
  print(' directive:', str(row['merged_directive_for_next'])[:600]); print(' delta:',str(row['delta_from_original'])[:300], 'drift',row['drift_signal'])
p=json.load(open('eval-log/run-dev-graph-system-spec-progress.json'))
print(json.dumps(p,ensure_ascii=False)[:1800])
PY
